Naked: Strong, toned physique with visible muscle definition, testament to her warrior's life.
Scars from past battles mark her skin, particularly on her arms and torso, telling tales of courage.
Story: Born into a clan of renowned warriors in Kaupang, Freya was trained from a young age in the art of battle.
She earned her place as a shieldmaiden through a rite of passage, single-handedly felling a charging wild boar.
Freya joined the crew of the 'Sea Serpent' seeking glory and adventure, quickly proving her worth as a steadfast and formidable warrior.
Her loyalty to her fellow shieldmaidens is absolute, and she will fight to her last breath to protect them.

Intimidating Presence (her focused gaze and powerful stance can unnerve opponents)

Description: A well-balanced battle axe with runic engravings along its haft, passed down through her warrior lineage.
A sturdy round shield, reinforced with iron and painted with a stylized raven motif, a symbol of Odin.
A wolf tooth amulet, worn around her neck for protection and strength.
A finely crafted drinking horn, used for mead and water.

Notes: Highly skilled with an axe and shield, preferring to be at the forefront of a shield wall.
Known for her unwavering loyalty to her comrades and the ship's cause.
Often seen sharpening her axe, a ritual that calms her before battle.
